---
title: "News"
listing:
  contents: posts
  sort: "date desc"
  type: default
  # Without `image`, Quarto does not keep an empty thumbnail column.
  fields: [date, author, title, subtitle, description, categories]
  categories: true
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: false
  feed: true
page-layout: full
title-block-banner: true
# Quarto loads MathJax on every listing page. The listing shows no maths.
html-math-method: plain
---
